rows.caption:
Happy Halloween ‍♂️

Stories of the Studio and Gallery

It’s a cool day but still a nice drive on the Green Gables Shore Route
We are off the St. Mary’s Road between Stanley Bridge and New Glasgow in Hope River! Look for the Blue Robert McMillan Pottery signs!

Robert and I are all dressed up to celebrate Halloween. We are dressed as two YOUNG Potters! lol


Robert’s getting my broom all warmed up for me just in case I want to fly around the Studio! 

But really he is hard at work trimming bowls, putting on handles, decorating and glazing and throwing different kinds of pots! Especially the Christmas mugs!

They will be ready for our Christmas Blitz next weekend! Friday - Sunday at Robert McMillan Pottery from 10-5pm

This weekend we have the same hours and this is what is on our shelves today! 

If you see something you like but just can’t make it by to the gallery or live in another province, let me know through messenger at Potter’s Wife of Hope River 
and I can help you out with that we do ship across Canada! 

⭐️There are just 2 weekends left to our pottery season and then we are closed here in Hope River. Our last day will be Nov 8th/26

If you would like hug mugs this would be your weekend to pick them out as many of the items today will be packed up at the end of our weekend so we can make room for our Christmas Blitz!

We will be at the Seaport Christmas Show in Mid November in Charlottetown.and that will finish off our year of sales and the two Potters will be taking a rest and celebrating Christmas!

So if you are looking to buy local we have lots of beautiful pots to choose from now! ❤️

Hope to see you this weekend 

17 Broadway Road, Hope River, PEI

We’ll have a good time then

I’ll keep you posted on the Christmas Mugs they should be coming soon!

@topfans

rows.caption:
On November 14 at 7:30 PM at Harmony House, Fiddler trio Rowen Gallant, Ray Knorr, and Romy Munkres will perform a live improvised score to Stella Maris, a 1918 Marshall Neilan picture starring Canada’s biggest silent‑era movie star, Mary Pickford. 

Stella Maris, written by Frances Marion, one of the most renowned female screenwriters of the early 20th century, tells the story of two young women, both played by Pickford in a dual role that required technical innovation to show her twice in the same shot, who fall in love with a man who is unhappily married.

Presented by Roving Picture Shows and Island Jazz as part of the Cné-Concert Series 

Tickets available at the door or right on Harmony House website. - link in our bio -

Original poster by Melissa Marie Morse

rows.caption:
ONTARIO, WE'RE COMING FOR YOU!! 

We're packing up a little taste of Prince Edward Island and heading to Ontario for our very first Longo's handpie sampling events!

And guess who's coming along? Our founder, Chef Sarah! ‍

Come say hello, enjoy some FREE delicious handpie bites, and discover why we're so passionate about making REAL comfort food, wrapped in our signature buttery, whole wheat pastry!

 HERE'S WHERE TO FIND US:

SATURDAY, NOVEMBER 7

 KITCHENER | 10:00 AM – 12:30 PM Longo's, 1950 Fischer-Hallman Rd, Unit F

 KLEINBURG | 3:15 PM – 6:00 PM Longo's, 6530 Major Mackenzie Dr W

SUNDAY, NOVEMBER 8

 WELLAND | 11:00 AM – 2:00 PM Longo's, 968 Niagara St

SATURDAY, NOVEMBER 14

 ETOBICOKE (QUEENSWAY) | 11:00 AM – 2:00 PM Longo's, 1055 The Queensway

✨ ON THE SAMPLING MENU: 
 BBQ Pulled Pork 
 PEI Pasty 
 Chicken Pot Pie

Every handpie is chef-made right here on Prince Edward Island, generously filled with hearty, delicious ingredients, and wrapped in our signature pastry made with real butter and whole wheat flour.

Ready to bake straight from frozen, they're comfort food without the compromise!

Already a handpie fan? Bring a friend! Never tried one? We'd LOVE to introduce you to your new favourite freezer staple!

 And if you spotted that Beet, Corn & Goat Cheese handpie in Chef Sarah's hands... let's just say there are more delicious things coming to Longo's very soon!

 ONTARIO FRIENDS, WHICH LOCATION WILL WE SEE YOU AT? Tag someone who needs to come along! 

#TheHandpieCompany #Longos #MadeInPEI #OntarioFood #CanadianMade

Dare I say it!!??

I think we might have the best guess the candy count jar on PEI (let me know if I am wrong)!

Not only does it contain A LOT of awesome candy (including a giant gobstopper) but it also includes $150 in Downtown Summerside giftcards to some of my favorite Downtown Summerside businesses including:
$25 to Art Buds 
$25 to Evermoore: Island Dining & Brewing 
$25 to Daisy-Mae Bookshop 
$25 to Vintage 
AND a $50 Holman's Giftcard!!!

Stop by anytime tomorrow before, during or after Witches on Water Street to place your guess on how many candys are in the jar! Whoever is closest wins the prize!!!

Not only that but we will be giving away candy AND Free Ice Cream coupons at our pumpkin ring toss from 12 - 3 and free candy will be available at the counter!

The witches slightly off of water street are back with some great fun!!! We look forward to seeing you tomorrow!!!!

P.S. we will be closing tomorrow at 4:30 to allow ourselves and our staff to fully enjoy Halloween!

Don’t forget to stop into Holmans for a sweet treat and a chance to WIN some great prizes ‍♀️
